kind: User-requested local browser acceptance and development cases; not held-out research
queries: large language models such as chatgpt
quality: Exact endpoint, a relevant general foundation, a representative reachable explanatory core, individually warranted connections, explicit boundaries and inspectable quotations. Counts alone cannot establish quality.
topic_checkpoints: Pattern transfer onto chip substrates; optical exposure and resist; diffraction/resolution or another relevant governing limit. Distinguish broad lithography from EUV-only scope.
Plasma activation, energetic electrons, precursor chemistry and film deposition; a governing electrical/chemical principle. Preserve unsupplied surface-chemistry gaps.
Propulsive motion and controlled return/recovery; Newtonian mechanics or momentum; distinguish landing from full operational reuse.
Parallel GPU hardware AND CUDA's kernel/thread programming model; shared/data parallel execution and memory limits. Graphics alone is insufficient.
Protein sequence-to-structure prediction, learned representations and relevant biological/physical foundations; state which AlphaFold generation is covered.
Language generation through conditional prediction, learned sequence representations/attention, and pretraining or instruction-following scope. Do not substitute an unrelated application.
rules: Real browser form and provider calls; no mocked evidence
One live exploration at a time, app concurrency unchanged
Preserve every attempt and usage receipt
Retest affected cases after substantive fixes
Never manufacture links to meet acceptance criteria
A model-generated check is not qualified human scientific review.
